_purpose: Pi-only extensions that agent-config supports across devices. Compaction is left to Pi's built-in text summarization; the Codex-native checkpoint extension is no longer supported. These are intentionally unpinned: setup receives upstream extension updates through Pi's installer. The list is separate from pi/settings.json because `packages[]` is written by Pi and may be co-owned by self-registering packages such as entwurf.
